title: fix(plugin-audit): name a lookup-titled record by its target's title in activity rows, and word boolean changes per locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKnsd8ZLsq9hBbRRm5JvJb2)_

Fixes #34055
Fixes #33830

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：活动动态里，名称字段是查找字段的记录（如 HotCRM 项目成员按「人员」命名）现在显示被引用记录的名称，不再显示 32 位 id；布尔字段的变更显示为当前语言的「是/否」，不再是 `false → true`。
- 为什么改：项目经理在活动动态里看到的是一串 id，和记录页标题对不上；中文界面里布尔值夹着英文字面量，与同一行已翻译的选项标签不一致。
- 风险与回滚：只影响此后新写入的活动行，已写入的行保持原样；每次写入最多多一次批量读取，且仅当名称字段是查找字段时才读。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`（记录标签按写入者身份读取目标名称的那段）、`activity-summary-message.ts`（布尔值按语言措辞）、`translations/messages.ts`（新增两个词条）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/activity-lookup-name-field-label-34055.test.ts src/activity-boolean-change-wording-33830.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件、18 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Lookup `nameField` labels (#34055).** `recordLabel` in `audit-writers.ts` now follows a title field that is a reference (`lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`) to the target record's own title. It reuses the resolver that already titles a referenced record inside a field-change summary, `resolveLookupTitles`. That gives ADR-0079's `titleFieldOf` on the target, the target's declared API exposure (`servesSummaryTitleTarget`, `get`), the credential / `internal` / key-material skips, and one `id: { $in }` read projected to `['id', titleField]`. A new `planLabelLookupRead` builds the plan. It is empty when the title field is not a reference or when the object mirrors no activity, so such writes pay no read. The record header gets its name from the data door's `$expand`, which reads as the reader. The writer's equivalent is to read as the WRITER, so `resolveLookupTitles` now takes the reader as a parameter. The two summary branches are unchanged. The label passes the hook's own `api`. When the writer is refused the target's title column, or is served the row without it, the label keeps the stored value. An id without a resolved title keeps the stored value too, so the change can only replace an id with a title. The label still declares the lookup field as its source (`text_sources.record_label`).

**Boolean wording (#33830).** `summaryValueOf` renders a `boolean` / `toggle` value with no matching declared option as `{ text: <English word>, boolean }`. `composeActivitySummary` words it through two new catalogue keys, `messages.activityValueTrue` / `messages.activityValueFalse`, in the locale it composes in. That is the write locale for the stored sentence, and the reader's negotiated locale on a read: the same request-locale path the verb templates take (the #32655 rule). The words are added to all eleven bundles of the plugin's `messages.ts`. `readActivitySummaryMessage` accepts the new optional member. A boolean field that declares options keeps reading through them. A fired milestone's template is the author's sentence and is never re-composed, so a boolean token there keeps its stored value.

## Tests

Two new files, named for the cards:

- `activity-lookup-name-field-label-34055.test.ts` (12 cases). Covers create / update / delete labels and sentences, a `user`-typed title, a multi-value lookup, and the blank-title floor. Read scope: a writer refused the title column, a writer served the row without it, the system writer, and a target whose exposure serves no `get`. Cost: one title read per write with `$in` over every id, and zero title reads for a text-titled object.
- `activity-boolean-change-wording-33830.test.ts` (6 cases), on a real SQLite driver through the read middleware. Covers zh-CN `已转化: 否 → 是` beside the option labels, the stored and en sentences, ja-JP, declared options winning, the stored code carrying the boolean, and the floor for a locale with no catalogue word.

The 7 that pass are the floors and controls, which hold on base by design (stored value kept, no read for a text title, declared options, a silent locale).

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope of the palette site.** The ⌘K palette's `renderTitle` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-record-reads.ts`, `searchAll`) is the same class, but it is not fixed here. The resolver this PR reuses is a closure inside plugin-audit, and `metadata-protocol` sits below it in the dependency graph. The engine-side equivalent (`$expand` on the title field) would change the `record` each hit returns on the wire. The report hands it to the seat for filing.
- **Test placement.** The dispatch asked for new files named for the cards. Neither component has a shared harness file (each audit suite carries its own harness), so ruling record 6583487846 does not move these into an existing file.
- **Already-written rows** keep the label and sentence they were written with. Snapshots are not rewritten.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only` against origin/main is clean. No open PR touches the changed files (file lists of all 80 open PRs read).

## Verification

Local gate subset: the `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` list derived at 49982fab3f (71 commands), with results in the report on the card. CI runs the full farm.
